sample_description: pristine anatase TiO2 thin film, DC magnetron sputtered (Ti target, Ar+O2) on cover glass / c-Si(100), annealed 450 C 2 h in room air; reference sample of the hollow-cathode H2-plasma (black TiO2) series
conditions: annealed 450 °C 2 h in air; no H2 plasma treatment (Pristine-TiO2)
notes: paper: Eg (Fig. 5a label; 'most intense Eg mode' in text); text says the five modes are observed around these positions 'for all samples' (Pristine and Black 15/30/45/60 min); Voigt fits with Gaussian width fixed at 1.6 cm-1; positions are 3-7 cm-1 below usual anatase values, copied as printed; the Eg(1) blue-shift/broadening of the plasma-treated films is shown only as stacked spectra (Fig. 5b, no numbers), so only the pristine reference is kept
